raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly decided to "normalize" the developer to its parent brand, conflating the developer (Crystal Dynamics) with the publisher/parent company (Square Enix). This led to instructing and later concluding that the game was developed by Square Enix, despite sources indicating Crystal Dynamics as the actual developer.
